signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Live at the center of our execution motion ensuring that all projects & stakeholders are focused, on track, unblocked, and cohesively organized
Partner deeply with all teams (Engineering, Design, Wealth Advisory, Client Experience, Investment Management) teams to turn our roadmap into documentation, prototypes, and…
Ensure we systematically incorporate client feedback & data religiously into our execution motion and product bets
Help launch new products and features that rapidly validate or invalidate hypotheses
Drive a culture where speed, courage, and experimentation are balanced with rigor, empathy, and a commitment to excellence
